Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Service Support: The OEM/Bidder shall provide a dedicated/toll-free helpline, escalation matrix and do cumentary proof of 15 service centres in Odisha, including complete addresses and service engineer conta ct details. 2. OEM Experience: The OEM must have a minimum of 15 years' business presence in India. A valid Certificate of Incorporation shall be submitted as documentary proof. 3. Odisha-Based Bidder: The bidder must possess a valid Odisha GSTIN and registered office/business p resence in Odisha, supported by documentary evidence. 4. Brand & OEM Authorization: The bidder shall specify the exact brand and model of each product and submit bid-specific OEM authorization for every product on the OEM's official letterhead. 5. Technical Compliance & Warranty: The OEM shall submit a duly signed Technical Compliance Sheet and Warranty Declaration on its official letterhead. 6. Product Documentation & Software: Official product datasheets shall be submitted. Original OEM s oftware, firmware and drivers must be available on the OEM's official website. An OEM declaration confirmi ng the same shall be submitted. 7. ISO Certifications: The OEM must possess valid ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO/IEC 27001 certifications. Copies of valid certificates shall be submitted along with the technical bid. 8. Other Applicable Certifications: The bidder/OEM shall submit applicable BIS, RoHS, CE, FCC, ISO 14 025, ISO/IEC 20000-1, ISO 45001, ITL 9000, SA8000, IEM acknowledgement and CPCB EPR documents, wh erever legally applicable to the offered products. 9. Financial Eligibility: The bidder shall submit CA-certified turnover certificates with valid UDIN, audited financial statements, ITRs and positive net worth for the last three financial years, as applicable under the prescribed eligibility criteria. 10. Price & Documentation: The quoted price shall be inclusive of all applicable taxes, transportation, in

stallation and other incidental charges. All mandatory documents and applicable corrigenda must be subm itted along with the bid. 11. Bid Rejection/Cancellation: The Authority reserves the right to reject non-responsive bids or cancel the tender in accordance with applicable GeM GTC, procurement rules and government guidelines. .
